purpose: The reviewed list of SQL files (supabase/proposed/*.sql and every file named by a docs/reviews/*/apply-plan.json, except the two CL-16 files) that mention public.nodes or the rule guard. scripts/run-g1-rule-guard-sql-test.sh fails when a file outside this list mentions them, so a new proposal that reads or writes the rule tree cannot appear without a review of its order against CL-16. Reviewed 13.11.2026 by reading each file; the M0 files (the 23 files of the M0 apply plan at PR #1321 commit 4a406fed2) and the CL-13 files do not mention the rule tree and are therefore not listed. Evidence for the two writers: cl16-order-evidence/.

reviewed.access: reads public.nodes (SELECT of the active owner laws, lines 95-104 and 166)
reviewed.effect_of_cl16: none: CL-16 changes nothing a SELECT depends on

reviewed.access: reads public.nodes (line 134: refuses while system_suggestions_law v7 is active)
WRITES public.nodes: deactivates system_suggestions_law v6 and inserts v7 (lines 67-72); then requires v6 to be byte-identical (metadata md5, lines 79-81)
reviewed.effect_of_cl16: if this file ran AFTER CL-16 it would fail its own post-check (the guard stamps metadata.rule_guard on the deactivated row, so the v6 metadata md5 changes); the 12.11.2026 laws snapshot shows system_suggestions_law v7 already active (md5 prefix a594e1fe21d4 = this file's text), so the file has already run before CL-16
reviewed.order_against_cl16: must precede CL-16; already satisfied live

reviewed.effect_of_cl16: after CL-16 the reactivation of the retired v6 is refused as a revival (needs owner_routing.resolution and an approval reference); this rollback no longer runs
reviewed.order_against_cl16: runs only before CL-16 (or after CL-16 has been rolled back); after CL-16 it needs a new, separately approved revival

reviewed.access: WRITES public.nodes: refuses unless the active writer_material_home_law is v6 with md5(description) b8be155d…; deactivates v6 and inserts v7 (v6 description + sections 43-49, v6 metadata + nested group_source_admission_v1, supersedes_version 6). Reviewed 24.11.2026 (#1514, PR #1546); REVIEW ONLY, not applied.
reviewed.effect_of_cl16: CL-16 is live (24.11.2026: trg_rule_compaction_integrity_guard_v1 and its TRUNCATE trigger enabled, function md5 90b5917b1412be02f66d1f805241018c = the CL-16 AFTER body). The guard requires an unambiguous immediate predecessor and governed metadata (compaction_v1, owner_routing, g3_disposition_v1), which v7 inherits from v6, and stamps metadata.rule_guard on the retired v6. The file does not re-check v6 metadata after the write, so the stamp does not break it. Verified on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 with the CL-16 AFTER body and the live v6 metadata: first run OK (v6 inactive and stamped, v7 active, v6 metadata keys kept, update nested); second run refused (Unexpected active writer_material_home_law v7) with nothing changed.
reviewed.order_against_cl16: runs after CL-16 (already live); no rollback file: reverting v7 is a governed supersession of its own under CL-16, with a separate ZURIEL approval
